svg.title: Square mats interlocking with square teeth

cc:Work.dc:title: Square mats interlocking with square teeth

text.tspan: Borders; there are two kinds of borders to use, depening on what edge
you are connecting. The border types are (1) left, top left, and bottom;
and (2) top middle, top right, or right. Because the mats have to
interlock, the edges can't be uniform, so different edges have different
How to use: these mats interlock with square teeth. They are aligned
such that the mats provide complete coverage with no gaps. The side
borders are used to make the teeth disappear. If you want to make the
teeth non-obvious, change the border color on the mat and borders to
the same color as the mat.
